Rooms.Name: On the Pier
Rooms.Description:
The weatherbeaten old house just to your south has clearly seen
better days.  The windows and doors have been boarded up as if to
protect the house from the battering winds and rain of a hurricane.  Or
perhaps to keep whatever is inside ... inside.  You can dive down into
the water from here, or head south into the house.

Exits.Description: A very large door marks the entrance to a creepy old house.
The deep green water of the mighty ocean looks warm and inviting.

Rooms.Name: The House
Rooms.Description:
You are wandering around a decrepit old house.  There are creaky     
stairs all over the place, and unexpected slides and broken floorboards.
The rooms all look vaguely alike.  Most feature a picture of one of the 
people who used to live here, but they are all so covered over with dust 
you can't make out what - or who - is in the picture.

Rooms.Name: Under the Sea
Rooms.Description:
Murky green, salty water surrounds you on all sides.  The water is
disorienting, making it difficult to remember which direction is up, or
even which direction you were going.  If you have gills, it is a
pleasant enough place to be.  The water is warm, and you are surrounded
by a wild variety of sea life, mostly friendly.

Rooms.Name: Under the Sea
Rooms.Description:
Murky green, salty water surrounds you on all sides.  The water is
disorienting, making it difficult to remember which direction is up, or
even which direction you were going.  If you have gills, it is a 
pleasant enough place to be.  The water is warm, and you are surrounded 
by a wild variety of sea life, mostly friendly.

Rooms.Name: A Small Cave Away from the Waves
Rooms.Description:
A small rocky ledge is all you can see of this cavern, although you
can tell from the way it echoes the lapping waves that it is quite
large.  Only the small ledge where you stand appears to be above water
however, and the only way out is back into the water, yet you feel safe
here, as if somehow you have arrived.
